title: RPL Target flags octet unchecked in production DAO ingest path (Rust, C)
description: Spec 05-routing.md §8.6 (R-05-035): 'The reserved RPL Target Flags octet MUST be zero; a nonzero value rejects the DAO before any route-state mutation.' Divergent: the verified production DAO path ignores the Target flags octet — Rust rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/routing.rs extract_updates:1486-1503 + dao_origin.rs envelope parse accept the generalized body (message.rs:436-438 is_generalized_target_body) and never check data[0]; C lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/rpl_dao_process.c:150-166 likewise. Python python/src/lichen/rpl/dao_origin.py:296-298 DOES reject nonzero flags. Codec-level check exists (rust/lichen-rpl/src/message.rs:706-720 RplTarget::from_bytes) but is used only by codec tests (rpl_messages_vectors.rs:128). No vector in test/vectors/dao_origin_signature.json pins nonzero Target flags in the signed-DAO set. Fix: wire the flags check into the verified ingest path in Rust + C and add a reject vector.
close_reason: Epic verified complete: all three children closed with landed work — b7z9.3.1 Rust ingest rejection (verified on main and now on beads-worker-4 post-merge: nonzero_target_flags_dao_rejected_before_state_mutation passes, extract_updates R-05-035 check present at rust/lichen-rpl/src/routing.rs:1486), b7z9.3.2 C rpl_dao_process.c (worker-1's close, verified by main merge), b7z9.3.3 vector reject_unsupported_dao_flags present in test/vectors/dao_origin_signature.json. lichen-rpl 237/237 green on my branch post-merge. Closing the parent per no-open-children rule.
